fields.title: Junior Software Engineer
fields.description: Took ownership of a React-based internal application following significant project disruption, delivering a production-ready system that replaced a slow legacy platform and reduced sales quote turnaround times. Refactored and rebuilt large portions of existing code, stabilizing incomplete and poorly structured components while delivering new features under minimal supervision. Designed and implemented UI improvements to enhance usability for non-technical sales staff, enabling the application to be rolled out for active internal use. Worked on a customer-facing payments portal, contributing to frontend development and API integration for online payments. Mentored a graduate developer, assigning tasks, supporting manual testing efforts, and helping build foundational skills in frontend development and SQL.

fields.title: Data Scientist
fields.description: Developed and maintained Python-based web scrapers using Selenium to collect training data for large language model workflows. Collaborated within a web scraping team, contributing scrapers and supporting other developers with debugging, data extraction logic, and scraper reliability. Implemented techniques such as user-agent rotation, cookie handling, and IP rotation to improve scraper robustness, and applied basic NLP processing to prepare data prior to ingestion.
